requirements.summary: Rebrand all user-facing naming/copy to “Maleeha Focus” (Pharm-D), English-only, removing Taruba/CEC/Muzzamil mentions.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title shows “Maleeha Focus”.
PWA manifest name/short_name and description reference “Maleeha Focus” and Pharm-D (not Taruba/CEC).
No user-facing text mentions Taruba, Muzzamil, or CEC after the change.
All user-facing text remains English only.

file_operations.description: Update document title and any remaining metadata copy to “Maleeha Focus” (English-only).
Update PWA manifest name/short_name/description to “Maleeha Focus” and Pharm-D context; remove Taruba/CEC references; keep colors consistent with the new palette.
Update Settings/About/footers to “Maleeha Focus” and Pharm-D wording; remove Taruba/CEC mentions in visible copy.
Update Attendance page heading/subheading copy to Pharm-D context and remove any CEC wording.
Update Focus page visible copy to match “Maleeha Focus” tone and ensure no Taruba/CEC/Muzzamil references remain.

requirements.summary: Replace task categories/subjects with the specified Pharm-D set and keep category selection/filtering working, including safe handling of stored legacy categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Category list contains exactly: “Pharm-D Study”, “Personal”, “Health & Routine”, “For Maleeha”.
Pharm-D Study subject list contains exactly: “Pharmaceutics”, “Medicinal Biochemistry”, “Human Anatomy and Physiology”, “Organic Chemistry”, “Inorganic Chemistry”, “Remedial Maths”.
When creating/editing a task, selecting “Pharm-D Study” exposes a subject picker; other categories do not.
Home category cards and the task filter bar reflect the new categories and correctly filter task lists.
Existing stored tasks from previous categories are handled safely (e.g., mapped or shown under a fallback) without crashing.

file_operations.description: Update task category and subject TypeScript unions/types from CEC/Taruba to the new Pharm-D categories + subjects.
Replace category list and subject list with the specified Pharm-D categories/subjects; update category-to-style mapping to match new category names.
Update category selection UI to the new categories; show the subject picker only when “Pharm-D Study” is selected; update labels/placeholders to match Pharm-D terminology.
Update Home category card config to match exactly the new categories, including icons and soft iOS-like tint styling per category.
Update filter bar to reflect the new categories and ensure selection styling works for “For Maleeha 🌸” without impacting other categories.
Update category-specific logic (counts, filtering, labels like “Categories”/“All Tasks”) to the new category names and preserve correct filtering behavior.

Add a safe in-frontend migration/normalization step when loading stored tasks so legacy categories/subjects (e.g., CEC Study/Workout/For Taruba) map to the new categories/subjects or a fallback, preventing crashes.

requirements.summary: Rename/implement the special category section as “For Maleeha 🌸” with 3 preset quick-add tasks, a flower completion indicator, and a pastel accent only within this section’s UI.
acceptanceCriteria: When “For Maleeha” is the selected category on Home, a quick-add card appears offering exactly the 3 preset tasks provided.
Quick-adding a preset creates a task in category “For Maleeha”.
Completed tasks in category “For Maleeha” display a flower icon indicator (and non-“For Maleeha” tasks do not use the flower indicator).
Only UI elements within the “For Maleeha” quick-add card and/or “For Maleeha” task styling use the special soft pastel accent; other categories keep the normal palette.

file_operations.description: Rename the quick-add component to reflect the “For Maleeha 🌸” section and prepare it for the new presets and accent styling.
Rename the presets constants file to a “For Maleeha 🌸” equivalent and replace the preset task titles with the 3 requested items.
Update the renamed quick-add card UI: title/copy must be “For Maleeha 🌸” and show exactly the 3 provided presets; apply a soft pastel accent only within this card.
Define exactly the 3 preset tasks verbatim: “Check on Maleeha’s day”, “Encourage her study”, “Family time reminder”.
Wire the renamed quick-add card to show only when the selected category is “For Maleeha 🌸”; ensure quick-add creates tasks in category “For Maleeha 🌸”.
Replace the current special completion indicator logic so only “For Maleeha 🌸” completed tasks show a flower icon indicator; ensure other categories do not show the flower indicator.
Add/update section-scoped utility classes (rename Taruba-specific utilities to Maleeha-specific) so the special soft pastel accent applies only within the “For Maleeha 🌸” UI elements.
Update Tailwind color tokens as needed to support a dedicated “For Maleeha 🌸” accent color used only for this section’s UI.

requirements.summary: Update the daily quote generator to use exactly the 20 provided “from Chotu” quotes, with random selection, manual refresh, and daily persistence preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: The quote source list contains exactly 20 quotes matching the user-provided text (including punctuation such as em dashes and apostrophes).
The app shows one quote at a time and allows manual refresh from the quote card.
A quote persists for the day and changes automatically when the calendar day changes (existing behavior preserved).
No quote attribution text displays a different name than “Chotu” (if attribution is displayed at all).

file_operations.description: Replace the existing quotes list with exactly the 20 user-provided “from Chotu” quotes verbatim; ensure the list length is exactly 20.
Ensure random quote selection draws from the updated 20-quote list; preserve existing daily persistence and manual refresh behavior.
Update quote attribution (if shown) to “Chotu” and ensure the refresh action remains available and functional.

requirements.summary: Apply the specified iOS-style theme palette across light/dark mode, including global theme tokens, category tint styling, and meta/manifest theme values.
acceptanceCriteria: Light theme surfaces/backgrounds match the requested palette (with appropriate contrast).
Dark mode remains available and readable; no hard-coded light-only colors break dark mode.
Category color styling is updated so the new categories have consistent, iOS-like soft tint styling.
Theme color meta/manifest values are consistent with the updated palette.

file_operations.description: Update global CSS theme variables for light/dark to match: Primary #FFD6E0, Secondary #D4C1FF, Background #FFF6F9, Success #C8FFD4, Text #2F2F2F; ensure readable dark mode equivalents and avoid hard-coded light-only colors.
Align Tailwind theme tokens (colors, ring, etc.) with the updated CSS variables and ensure category tint styling remains consistent with the new palette.
Update meta theme-color (and any related theme metadata) to be consistent with the updated palette.
Update manifest background_color/theme_color to be consistent with the updated palette and overall iOS-style theme.
Update category card gradient/border tint classes to match the new iOS-style palette and category set.

requirements.summary: Update typography: iOS system-style fonts for general UI and a soft handwritten font for quotes without layout issues.
acceptanceCriteria: General UI text uses system font stacks appropriate for iOS (San Francisco-style).
Quote text uses a handwritten/cursive font style distinct from the main UI text.
Typography changes do not introduce layout overflow/clipping in the quote card.

file_operations.description: Switch general UI font stacks to iOS/system (San Francisco-like) for body/headings; keep a distinct handwritten/cursive font for quote text and validate quote card line-height/spacing to prevent overflow.
Update Tailwind fontFamily tokens to use system font stacks for sans/heading and preserve a dedicated quote font family for handwritten styling.
Adjust font loading declarations to reflect the new typography choices (system-first for UI; optional handwritten font for quotes).
Validate and adjust quote text styling (font class, sizing, wrapping) to avoid clipping/overflow with the handwritten style.

requirements.summary: Ensure Home layout matches the requested structure (today’s date + quote card at top, category cards in middle, floating add button at bottom) and date shows today.
acceptanceCriteria: Home shows today’s date at the top.
Quote card appears near the top beneath the date.
Category cards appear in the middle with iOS-like rounded styling.
A floating add button is fixed near the bottom and opens the task creation dialog.

file_operations.description: Confirm/adjust TopBar date formatting to always display today’s date clearly in English and match the refreshed “Maleeha Focus” styling.
Confirm/adjust Home composition order and spacing to match: Date + Quote card at top, category cards in middle, floating add button at bottom; ensure add button opens the task creation dialog.
Confirm/adjust floating button positioning and iOS-style rounding/shadow so it remains fixed near the bottom and remains accessible across content lengths.

requirements.summary: Preserve existing task CRUD (title/description/time, edit, delete, complete) and ensure reliable offline/local persistence after reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create tasks with title, optional description, and optional time.
Users can edit and delete tasks.
Users can mark tasks completed/uncompleted.
Tasks persist via local storage and are still present after a full page reload.
Core flows continue to work with no network connectivity.

file_operations.description: Ensure task CRUD behavior remains intact while integrating category/subject updates and legacy-data normalization; keep local/offline persistence stable.
Verify the task form still supports title, optional description, and optional time; ensure edit vs add flows remain correct with updated category/subject fields.
If needed, extend local storage helpers to support safe data versioning/migration for tasks so older stored categories/subjects do not break the app offline.

requirements.summary: Maintain a 45-minute focus timer with short break and iOS-style progress ring, and represent “Do Not Disturb” only as in-app distraction reduction (no OS-level claims).
acceptanceCriteria: Focus phase duration is 45 minutes and break starts automatically after the focus timer completes.
The progress ring animates smoothly during the timer.
The UI provides an in-app distraction reduction mode (e.g., hide non-essential UI) and does not claim to toggle the phone’s OS-level Do Not Disturb.

file_operations.description: Verify and enforce 45-minute focus duration and automatic short break behavior; preserve progress updates needed for smooth ring animation.
Confirm the progress ring animation remains smooth and iOS-like with the updated theme palette (colors/contrast in light and dark).
Adjust copy/labels to clearly communicate in-app distraction reduction (no OS-level Do Not Disturb control).
Ensure distraction reduction mode hides non-essential UI as intended and all text avoids OS-level DND claims; keep 45-min + break messaging consistent.
Confirm global navigation hiding behavior during focus mode aligns with in-app distraction reduction and does not affect other pages.

requirements.summary: Update Attendance Tracker wording for Pharm-D context while preserving subject management, present/absent marking, percentage stats, and monthly calendar.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add/edit/delete subjects in Attendance.
Users can mark days as Present/Absent per subject.
Attendance percentage and counts display correctly.
Monthly calendar view remains available and usable.
Any CEC-specific wording is removed from the Attendance UI.

file_operations.description: Update Attendance UI headings/subheadings and any helper text to align with Pharm-D context and remove CEC-specific wording while keeping existing functionality unchanged.
Review and update any visible copy/labels in the subject list management dialogs to ensure Pharm-D-appropriate, English-only wording.
Review and update any visible copy/labels to ensure English-only Pharm-D context while preserving stats calculations and display.
Review and update any calendar UI copy/labels if needed (English-only), preserving monthly navigation and present/absent marking behavior.

requirements.summary: Add an App Store description section in Settings (or About) showing the provided description verbatim in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings includes a readable section showing the provided App Store description text verbatim.
The description is displayed in English only and references Maleeha and Chotu as provided.

file_operations.description: Add a new section in Settings/About that displays the provided App Store description text verbatim (English-only), and keep the rest of Settings consistent with “Maleeha Focus” branding.
